inputs.name: ImageBytesValidator.validate.value
inputs.description: The image bytes from the image generator that validate checks on every call. The value must be a Uint8Array instance, and planImageCodec then requires a length from 33 to 33,554,432 bytes inclusive, nonzero big-endian width and height read from byte offsets 16 and 20 (the PNG IHDR fields) whose product is at most 32,000,000, and a pngjs decode that succeeds with CRC checking enabled.

outputs.name: ImageBytesValidator.validate
outputs.description: The same Uint8Array object that was passed in, returned by reference rather than as a copy and only after planImageCodec accepts the bytes. The width and height that planImageCodec decodes are discarded, so callers receive the original bytes rather than the dimensions.

errors.name: InvalidImageBytesError
errors.description: Thrown as an Error with the message 'Image generator did not return image bytes.' when the input is not a Uint8Array instance, before planImageCodec runs. Otherwise planImageCodec throws an Error with code 'invalid-image': 'Expected a complete PNG under 32 MiB' for fewer than 33 or more than 33,554,432 bytes, 'Image dimensions exceed limit' for a zero width or height or a width times height above 32,000,000, or 'PNG decoding failed' when pngjs throws while decoding, and validate does not catch it.
